557:t_015:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「And while I'm at it, that irritating way of talking... I'll admit you're the real $$宗介$$.」

557:t_015:33.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But it's wasted effort. The preparations for $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$ are already finished.」

557:t_015:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Soon the Iota wave emission will begin, and I will create a new world.」

557:t_015:35.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Sure, a lot of people will die, but soon this cruel world will end, and a new world will...」

557:t_015:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「You keep quiet. I'm talking to $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

557:t_015:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What are you talking about? I'm $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

557:t_015:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're not her at all. You're $$ソフィア$$.」

557:t_015:43.en:
$$かなめ$$
「She died long ago... 18 years ago. At that $$ヤムスク１１$$.」

557:t_015:45.en:
$$宗介$$
「Did you think I'd go out of my way to persuade you in a tearful voice, on a battlefield of all places?」

557:t_015:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「Sorry to disappoint. What I'm riding is not a $$ガンダム$$, it's an AS.」

557:t_015:47.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't make me laugh. I came here to get in your way and cause you as much trouble as I possibly can.」

557:t_015:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「Since it's convenient, I'll say this to everyone listening in on this transmission. Listen carefully.」

557:t_015:49.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm going to ruin everything for you.」

557:t_015:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「My specialties are arson and destruction. That worthless occult device you're so desperately worshipping - I'll turn it into a pile of pathetic junk in five seconds.」

557:t_015:51.en:
$$宗介$$
「Go on, beg pitifully. Say, 'Stop it, this is our hope!'」

557:t_015:52.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm dying to see you wail and cry. Go on, snivel and make your excuses like the wretches you are: 'We're so hurt,' 'Let this world just vanish'...」

557:t_015:53.en:
$$宗介$$
「It'll make a great picture. I'll record everything and broadcast your miserable state to the whole world!」

557:t_015:54.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll put you on display and make you a laughingstock for the next 12,000 years! Be prepared!」

557:t_015:56.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What we're seeking is a gentler, more delicate world... That's all.」

557:t_015:57.en:
$$かなめ$$
「One with healing, harmony and transparency, and yet vivid...」

557:t_015:60.en:
$$宗介$$
「What healing, what transparency? I'll smear it with germ-ridden crap!」

557:t_015:61.en:
$$宗介$$
「Besides, this isn't about whether you understand or not. I've decided to do it. You have to stop me with everything you've got.」

557:t_015:62.en:
$$宗介$$
「This is what war is. Simple coercion, and the exchange of it... I love it!」

557:t_015:65.en:
$$宗介$$
「Thank you for your kind attention.」

557:t_015:66.en:
$n
「That was masterful. You said what I wanted to say, too.」

557:t_015:67.en:
$$宗介$$
「Was it the 'no consideration at all' part? Or the 'you're a terrible woman' part?」

557:t_016:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm fine. I twisted my body and avoided a direct hit.」

557:t_016:3.en:
$$アル$$
「However, the shoulder unit was damaged. The $$妖精の羽$$ can no longer be used.」

557:t_016:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「So I have to fight him without it.」

557:t_017:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「So you showed up, $$レナード$$.」

557:t_017:1.en:
$n
「You still had that many $$ベヘモス$$s!」

557:t_017:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's literally an all-out war.」

557:t_017:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「But we're the ones who will win.」

557:t_017:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「I heard your fine lecture earlier. Quite amusing. It seems you knew she was $$ソフィア$$.」

557:t_017:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Of course. I heard it from $$テッサ$$.」

557:t_017:6.en:
$$宗介$$
(Right now, $$ソフィア$$ isn't aware that she has taken over $$千鳥$$. She believes she is the real $$千鳥$$.)

557:t_017:7.en:
$$宗介$$
(If $$千鳥$$'s heart still exists somewhere, all I can do is entrust the rest to her.)

557:t_017:8.en:
$$宗介$$
(The only words I can convey to her are those insults and provocations. But they're the strongest words I know.)

557:t_017:9.en:
$$宗介$$
(Words that sound like me will surely reach her better than love words I'm not used to using.)

557:t_017:10.en:
$$レナード$$
「You figured that approach would be effective for calling out to the real her... How like you, so single-minded.」

557:t_017:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「You seem to have special feelings for $$千鳥$$ too. But that woman and she are different. Knowing that, how can you do this so calmly?」

557:t_017:13.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's all for the plan.」

557:t_017:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「So you're determined to deny the present world.」

557:t_017:15.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm only restoring it to how it should be.」

557:t_017:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「We're going in circles. There's no talking to you.」

557:t_017:17.en:
$$レナード$$
「In the end, we couldn't even become archenemies. Ours was merely a relationship of getting in each other's way.」

557:t_017:19.en:
$$レナード$$
「Then all that's left is to settle it in battle.」

557:t_017:21.en:
$$レナード$$
「Stay out of this, $$テレサ$$.」

557:t_018:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Close the bulkheads! Tell them to hurry with the fire suppression!」

557:t_018:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レナード$$. I'll be your opponent.」

557:t_018:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Can you dodge it? This Isaian Bone Bow.」

557:t_018:5.en:
$n
「Watch out, $$宗介$$! That bow seems to be converting the power of the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ directly into attack energy!」

557:t_018:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's not only invisible, I can't even block it with a force field!」

557:t_018:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We've located $$カナメ$$! Ground combat units, move in!」

557:t_018:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Be careful! The one commanding the enemy infantry is most likely $$カリーニン$$!」

557:t_018:11.en:
$$レナード$$
「Come on, $$相良$$! $c! I'll begin the transformation of the world right before your eyes!」
